line.en: the stage at macondo in via del pratello is open to anyone on tuesdays. wind and percussion instruments are not allowed, so bring a guitar or your voice.
line.de: die bühne im macondo in der via del pratello steht dienstags jedem offen. blasinstrumente und percussion sind nicht erlaubt, also gitarre oder stimme mitbringen.
line.tr: via del pratello'daki macondo'nun sahnesi salı günleri herkese açık. üflemeli ve vurmalı çalgılar kabul edilmiyor; gitar ya da sesinle gel.

sparks.why: Macondo open mic, weekly on tuesdays at via del pratello 22, per the zero.eu listing for the venue; wind and percussion instruments excluded. The start time is a suggestion, check the venue.
